$comment: The Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable the Windows installer runs (installer-hooks.nsh), pinned by SHA-256 and staged by scripts/ci/stage-vc-redist.mjs. The url is the versioned download behind https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe (its path carries the SHA-256); read on 2026-11-11. To move the pin, take the new url from that redirect, download it, check that the SHA-256 in the path matches the bytes and that Windows shows a valid Microsoft Authenticode signature, then edit this file. Why the package and not app-local DLLs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files (central deployment is recommended because Microsoft services the libraries; app-local is not recommended).
